_sources: OSRS Wiki (Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup) for requirements, XP and favour; rsprox 227/01858, 237/01102 and 231/03030 for timings, messages, sounds, animations, varbits and the stick claims. Gameval names, resolved from the cache. Part 3 (rewards): the Wiki's Gabooty's Tai Bwo Wannai Cooperative, Safta Doc, Rionasta and Hardwood Grove pages; rsprox 227/01858, 237/01102, 227/01757 and 231/03030 for the shop messages, Safta's machete, the grove doors and Murcaily's warning; the cache for the parcel interface's ops (scripts 2851/2855).

messages.notTold: Perhaps you should check with the local villagers before you start hacking away at the local vegetation?
messages.noMachete: You need to be holding a machete to cut away this jungle.
messages.level: You need a Woodcutting level of {level} to hack this jungle.
messages.fullInventory: You have no space in your inventory for any further thatching spars.
messages.cutBack: This jungle has been cut back to the ground.
messages.favourFull:
Your Favour total is now full, you cannot gain any more.
Talk to the villagers to get favour converted to trading sticks.
messages.notToldFence: Perhaps you should check with the local villagers before you start repairing the village fence?
messages.noSpars: You need some thatching spars in order to repair this fence.
messages.noFenceMachete: You need a machete to repair this fence.
messages.skewers: You hack the spar into skewers.
messages.firstClaim: Great, I saw you were fixing the fence earlier, it looks like you've got the hang of this now! Let me give you something for your effort!
messages.claim: Hey, I've seen you working around the village. You've been doing a lot of good work around here for us. Let me give you something for your trouble.
messages.claimed: You get {sticks} trading sticks. You are left with {favour}% favour.
messages.noRoom: You don't have enough inventory space.
messages.parcelCurrency: You cannot send any form of currency through the parcel service
messages.parcelRum: The villager refuses to send this through the parcel system.
messages.parcelNoSticks: You don't have enough trading sticks to send that.
messages.parcelValue: {item}: it costs 10 trading sticks per item to send.
messages.parcelTooFew: It costs at least 10 trading sticks to use this service. Sorry but you don't have enough.
messages.groveWarn: Hey there! You can't chop those trees until you've helped out around our village!
messages.groveAnyway: I just want to go in anyway.
messages.groveFee: You need 100 trading sticks to enter the Hardwood Grove.
messages.groveLeave:
You don't seem to have any Teak or Mahogany logs.
Are you sure you wish to leave?
messages.groveLeaveYes: Yes, I wanna get out of here!
messages.groveLeaveNo: Erk! No, I want to stay in the grove.
messages.groveChop: You need to have helped clean up Tai Bwo Wannai village before cutting down these trees.  You should leave through the gates into the main village.
